lines: What is the Unsurpassable, Kaula-fruiting of itself,
that by mere knowing brings Khecarī-evenness?
l4.sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva svataḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet

reads_against.argmap: The question seeks the how of the unsurpassable that grants Kaula accomplishment by autonomy, known by mere recognition.
c1_essence: Unsurpassable asked: Kaula fruit by autonomy, mere knowing to Khecarī-evenness.
